SKM DCAM: 3D printing in a higher dimension!
CAM software for complex path planning with sophisticated kinematic systems in additive and hybrid processes - with metals, plastics, ceramics or multi-material.

With special expertise in the development of sophisticated graphic applications, SKM implements international individual customer projects with its own solution platforms SKM-DCAM (3D Printing / Additive Manufacturing / CNC & Robotics), SKM-TT-PLANT (BIM / plant construction) and SKM-XR (Augmented & Virtual Reality).

Thanks to a broad network in research and industry, SKM drives forward specific products and digitalization processes with a focus on Industry 4.0, Additive Manufacturing, Robotics, Digital Twins, Cloud Computing, Machine Learning and cyber-physical data equivalence.
